paper.title: Single Miller Capacitor Frequency Compensation Technique for Low-Power Multistage Amplifiers

recommended_controls.name: MOSFET_10_1_M_gm2_PMOS
recommended_controls.role: second-stage signal-device multiplicity; current and parasitics are coupled

recommended_controls.name: MOSFET_23_1_M_gm3_NMOS
recommended_controls.role: output-stage signal-device multiplicity; current and parasitics are coupled

recommended_controls.name: MOSFET_8_2_M_gm1_PMOS
recommended_controls.role: matched first-stage input-pair multiplicity; changes effective width, not a direct gm value

release.notes: One Miller capacitor from first-stage output net050 to VOUT; separate feedforward PMOS drives output. Not the two-stage simple Miller topology also abbreviated SMC. Original uses 0.5um CMOS, +/-1V supply (2V rail span), 120pF parallel 25kohm; release uses SKY130 and CLOAD=10pF.
release.schematic_visual_review_scope: AnalogGym released schematic only; original schematic review recorded separately in paper.review_level

adaptations: Netlist and original fixed parameter file copied unchanged.
Project-authored follower/AC testbench at 1.8 V, 27 C, SKY130 TT; released CLOAD/VCM retained.
Project-selected editable bounds and simulation-guided targets; no recovery of paper performance.
Large-signal settling uses a 20 mV absolute band for a 200 mV step (10%).
